title: CONSIDER: A. ESTABLISHING a Life-of-Project budget for the Vermont Transit Corridor Bus Rapid Transit (BRT) Project in the amount of $413,786,609; and B.…
text:
[Metro Board file 2026-0658, Budget]
[CONSTRUCTION COMMITTEE MADE THE FOLLOWING RECOMMENDATION (3-0):]
CONSIDER:

A.	ESTABLISHING a Life-of-Project budget for the Vermont Transit Corridor Bus Rapid Transit (BRT) Project in the amount of $413,786,609; and

B.	AUTHORIZING the Chief Executive Officer to negotiate and execute project-related agreements up to the authorized Life-of-Project budget.
summary: Establishing a Life-of-Project budget of $413,786,609 for the Vermont Transit Corridor Bus Rapid Transit (BRT) Project and authorizing the CEO to execute project-related agreements.

locations.text: Vermont Ave & Sunset Blvd, Los Angeles, CA
Vermont Ave & 120th St, Los Angeles, CA

details.action: Budget authorization and CEO authorization for agreements

flag.reason: Funds the Vermont Ave bus rapid transit line through Koreatown and East Hollywood, a corridor Ian travels and where street-tree removals were recently posted.
